body:
MAINLINE-015 independently checked; Baizhikova 2026, López Jiménez 2017 and Gerasimidis/Virot/Hutchinson/Rubinstein 2018 read directly. Owner scripts were neither read nor executed.

The beryllium/5056-core correction holds. Frozen wrinkling remains 0.6688192083. Re-optimising at kd 0.3 gives least SF 0.8536141922 on the grid and 0.8537545539 continuously. Continuous SF 1 threshold is kd 0.5183040769, with global buckling and face yield active; 0.519 is the first passing 0.001 grid point.

Tolerance conclusions require correction. The prominent RMS mixes a lambda 1 amplitude with lambda 2.625 width. Matching width and declared nu 0.33 gives kd 0.9 RMS 0.174459567 mm for P2-E and 0.039472526 mm for Be/core. That inverse is outside the source's small-defect regime. Filed widths instead imply nu 0.30. Lee 2016 Eq. 23 supplies the missing lower-kd envelope, with explicit range limits.

CHECK.md derives both equivalent stiffnesses and records exact source and numeric discrepancies. 599 numeric comparisons are preserved; 193 differences primarily repeat the nu convention. All 264 shell fields reproduce with inferred nu 0.30. Fourteen nonblocking NFI rows cover width/range, effective modulus, shear, density, one-face thinning, citations, manufacturing provenance, projection tags and reliability consistency. Material and sandwich-transfer estimates remain QUESTIONABLE; CNT/graphene scenarios remain PROJECTION.

Artifacts are pinned below. No successor job is named; stopping and awaiting a queue assignment.
